ideal: Every Mac app change on main builds, passes its tests and makes a sandboxed app that passes its bundle check, within ten minutes.

sources.title: DevOps Research and Assessment: Continuous integration

quality: Every Swift job on main's code passes, and each app it builds has the right identity, its entitlements and a signature that verifies.
speed: A Swift job answers, pass or fail, within ten minutes, the upper limit for build and test feedback.
consumption: Each Swift job costs as few macOS dollars as it can, since a macOS minute costs about ten Linux minutes.
